001_h1: Separate points of light. One shape.
002_p: The living collection of neighbor expressions — every MEWE story, act, and creation. Alone, a single point. Together, a shape none of us makes on our own.
007_div: Prototype v1 — all copy is draft; seed entries are placeholders. Arrange by Time and by ME=WE Arc, contributor filter, and inline playback come in v2.
009_p: Make something, or notice something. A few honest sentences, a drawing, a photo, a film, a song.
010_p: Share it through the Story form. One thing, one caption. Fifteen minutes is enough.
011_p: It appears here as a new light. Everything you add appears in the Constellation we are creating together. Some stories are also chosen for the Story page.
012_p: Add as many as you like. Each one joins your name's own small constellation.
013_p: Anyone can add — no workshop needed. And IN keeps adding too: every workshop ends with participants placing their pieces here. Many pieces begin in the Möbius Making workshop.
016_h2: Add your light to the collection.
